text:
Controlling for inflation and PPP, Japan's GDP per capita rose roughly 8- to 10-fold from 1950 to 2016—from about $3,000–4,000 to $38,000–40,000 in 2011 international dollars—with most growth in the 1950s–1970s. The team note's claim of a 1950 level near $8,000 is too high for standard PPP series, which would imply only a ~5-fold rise. My conclusion stands: roughly an 8- to 10-fold increase.
CONFIDENCE: 80
